text:
incidents-bot: ALERT: We are seeing a spike in duplicated/retroactive responses for hosted text-generation requests (root cause suspected: request-id collision causing retry loops). Customers may see repeated tokens and unexpected billing. Investigating. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2056001234-request-id-collision (live updates)

maria-sre: Observed correlation with a recent change in the edge-proxy that switched to a short request-id namespace (hash32). Looks like collisions under high concurrency. 5xx rate up ~2.4x in us-east1 and request duplication rate ~0.8%.

kevin-runtime: rolling back the proxy change now to restore 64-bit request ids. Starting canary rollback on us-east1-frontend-01. ETA ~7m. If rollback fails we'll toggle legacy request-id generation in the runtime.

anya-support: Opening a customer-facing notice. Draft pinned in #support-ops: "We are experiencing duplicated responses for some API requests; we are rolling back a configuration change and will update within 30 minutes." @jonah-product please ok tone.

jonah-product: tone is fine. Add note: customers who saw duplicate tokens will not be billed for duplicates — billing team to apply credits automatically. @anya-support add link to support form and opt-in for expedited credit.

maria-sre: Mitigation steps executed so far:
- rollback of edge-proxy config started at 2056001301
- temporarily increased dedupe-window on backend at 2056001320
- global rate-limit bump (short term) to reduce retry amplification

kevin-runtime: Canary rollback completed on us-east1-frontend-01 at 2056001605: error rate down 60% on that canary. Rolling to remaining frontends in 3 waves. Patch PR: https://git.redwood.ai/r/redwood/edge-proxy/pulls/482

ops-automation-bot: @maria-sre triggered incident runbook step "request-id-collision" and created pager rota notifications. Link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/request-id-collision

anya-support: Sent customer notice v1 at 2056001700. Support queue spike expected, routing instructions in pinned message.

maria-sre: Current status: partial mitigation in progress. Most customer traffic should see normal behavior within the next 20-30m. Root cause postmortem will follow once stabilized. Next update in 15m or on significant change. If you have threads with affected customers, @anya-support is coordinating replies.

kevin-runtime: Quick ops note for eng-runtime: grep logs to confirm collisions:
```
# count requests with same req_id within 1s window
cat nginx-access.log | awk '{print $11}' | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head
```
Look for identical req_id counts >1.

maria-sre: Timeline so far:
- 2056001200: change deployed to edge-proxy (hash32 request id)
- 2056001250: first dup reports from synthetic monitors
- 2056001301: rollback started
- 2056001605: canary rollback success

anya-support: Support quick responses ready (copy/paste):
"Thanks — we detected duplicated responses and have rolled back the change causing it. We are applying credits for duplicate usage; please submit ticket if you still see duplicates. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2056001234-request-id-collision"

maria-sre: Closing note: if any team sees lingering duplicates after full rollback completes (expected by 2056003034), @kevin-runtime to collect traces and @maria-sre will trigger a failover to older proxy build. We'll attach postmortem draft to the status page.

incidents-bot: Update posted to status page. Next automated reminder in 15 minutes. :rotating_light:
